Every dispatch attack is refuted. The candidate nevertheless carries one MUST-FIX: findingDisposition.claudeV29M1 was rewritten this cycle to assert that registerRowNote's unrecorded recital contains leftover-join.v33 of G21, and it does not, while live COORD confirms v33 is in fact unrecorded and the accepted leftover-join.v32 of G21 precedent added exactly that recital entry for its own rejected predecessor. One SHOULD-FIX stands for the same incomplete v33 sweep at three further enumerations. Under the stated rule the verdict is REJECT; the findings land at a successor of leftover-join.v34 of G21.
